description: This Java source file defines the ICalWorker class, which handles WebDAV and iCalendar (iCal) related HTTP requests such as GET, PUT, and PROPFIND for work effort entities in the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for handling calendar retrieval, updates, and WebDAV property discovery, delegating calendar conversion tasks to the ICalConverter class, and managing HTTP responses accordingly.

classes.name: ICalWorker
classes.description: Final class providing static methods to handle WebDAV-based HTTP requests for calendar data related to work efforts, including GET, PROPFIND, and PUT requests, as well as response creation and user session management.

classes.name: ICalWorker.ResponseProperties
classes.description: Inner class representing HTTP response properties such as status code and message, used for communicating results of calendar operations.

methods.name: createConversionContext
methods.description: Creates a context map with request attributes, parameters, and locale for use in calendar conversions.

methods.name: createForbiddenResponse
methods.description: Constructs a response indicating HTTP 403 Forbidden.

methods.name: createNotAuthorizedResponse
methods.description: Constructs a response indicating HTTP 401 Unauthorized.

methods.name: createNotFoundResponse
methods.description: Constructs a response indicating HTTP 404 Not Found.

methods.name: createOkResponse
methods.description: Constructs a response indicating HTTP 200 OK.

methods.name: createPartialContentResponse
methods.description: Constructs a response indicating HTTP 206 Partial Content.

methods.name: getLastModifiedDate
methods.description: Retrieves the last modified timestamp for the work effort's iCal data, if available.

methods.name: handleGetRequest
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests for calendar data, returning the iCalendar for a given work effort.

methods.name: handlePropFindRequest
methods.description: Handles HTTP PROPFIND requests to discover properties of the calendar resource.

methods.name: handlePutRequest
methods.description: Handles HTTP PUT requests to update or store calendar data for a work effort.

methods.name: isValidRequest
methods.description: Validates that the request is secure and properly set up for processing.

methods.name: logInUser
methods.description: Performs user login via web service, setting authenticated user info into request/session.

methods.name: setupRequest
methods.description: Initial request setup, extracting work effort ID from URL and performing login.

methods.name: writeResponse
methods.description: Sends an HTTP response with the specified status code and message.
